# LoomiHome Patios

LoomiHome Patios provides aluminum patio covers, glass patio covers, skyline combo patio covers, and sunroom enclosures in Metro Vancouver.

## Services
- Aluminum patio cover installation
- Glass patio cover installation
- Skyline combo patio covers
- Sunroom enclosures
- On-site measurement and installation

## Service Areas
Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Delta, Langley, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, New Westminster, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, and nearby Metro Vancouver areas.

## Pricing
Aluminum patio covers are about $8–10 per sq ft plus a $500 base fee.
Glass patio covers are about $10–12 per sq ft plus a $500 base fee.
Sunrooms usually start from about $38–45 per sq ft.
Final price depends on size, material, wall condition, posts, beams, and onsite measurement.
